# migration-runner

> Run versioned SQL migrations against SQLite with a cross-process lock table, checksums of applied files, transactional apply and rollback, and a dry-run plan. Python package `trysac-migration-runner`, import name `migration_runner`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies outside the standard library.
